mapper.select:
SELECT s.id, s.slug, s.name_zh, s.name_en, s.status, s.sort_order, s.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM software_release r WHERE r.software_id = s.id) AS release_count, (SELECT r2.version FROM software_release r2 WHERE r2.software_id = s.id AND r2.status = 1 ORDER BY r2.published_at IS NULL, r2.published_at DESC, r2.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_version FROM software s
AND (s.slug LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name_zh LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.name_en LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND s.status = #{status}
ORDER BY s.sort_order ASC, s.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO software (slug, name_zh, name_en, tagline_zh, tagline_en, intro_zh, intro_en, tech_stack, license, cover_url, theme_color, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{slug}, #{nameZh}, #{nameEn}, #{taglineZh}, #{taglineEn}, #{introZh}, #{introEn}, #{techStack}, #{license}, #{coverUrl}, #{themeColor}, #{status}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE software SET slug = #{slug}, name_zh = #{nameZh}, name_en = #{nameEn}, tagline_zh = #{taglineZh}, tagline_en = #{taglineEn}, intro_zh = #{introZh}, intro_en = #{introEn}, tech_stack = #{techStack}, license = #{license}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, theme_color = #{themeColor}, sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE software SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
